_note:
Settings for the site navigation, shown in wp-admin as its own page the same way Brand info is. Chrome slots have NO {{token}} — they are read by PHP before any fragment is fetched — so --check proves the coupling differently: every key here must be read in vc-clients-embed.php or the field would accept input that changes nothing.

WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE, following Oak + Elm's ruling on the same component: the breakpoint, the sticky behavior, the bar's background style, color and opacity, and every duration and easing. Sean's call there was admin options for CONTENT, SPACING and ORDER, with the look and the motion fixed by design — a per-page background color is how a nav stops looking like one nav. Those remain shortcode attributes on [brg_nav] for the rare page that genuinely differs.

logo.label: Logo
logo.doc: The mark in the bar. An SVG stays crisp at any size and is what the bar is built around. Leave empty and the bar falls back to the logo configured in the plugin.

logo_size.label: Logo height
logo_size.doc: How tall the logo is in the bar, in pixels. The design sits around 32. The bar sizes itself from its contents, so a taller logo makes a taller bar — and it still scales down when the page scrolls.

logo_href.label: Logo links to
logo_href.doc: Where clicking the logo goes. Normally the home page. Worth checking if a temporary landing page is ever sitting at the root.

link_size.label: Link size
link_size.doc: The size of the words in the bar, in pixels. The design sits around 13.

link_gap.label: Space between links
link_gap.doc: The gap between one link and the next, in pixels. Tighten this before reducing the size when a long menu is close to wrapping.

left.label: Links before the logo
left.doc: Only used by the layouts that put links on both sides of a centered logo. Anything past this count moves into the More menu rather than crowding the bar.

right.label: Links after the logo
right.doc: As above, for the other side. On a logo-left layout this is the only one that counts.

more_label.label: “More” label
more_label.doc: The wording on the button that opens the overflow menu when there are more links than fit the counts above.

follow_label.label: Social heading, in the phone menu
follow_label.doc: The small heading above the social icons inside the phone menu.

show_numbers.label: Number the phone menu
show_numbers.doc: The 01, 02, 03 running down the phone menu. Off leaves just the words.

show_social.label: Social row in the phone menu
show_social.doc: Whether the social icons appear at the foot of the phone menu. They come from the menu assigned to BRG — Social under Appearance → Menus; hiding them here leaves that menu alone.
